decisions.foundation: Replace the linear one-currency architecture; preserve only useful concepts.
decisions.audit: High-level direction survives, but implementation requires falsifiable evidence.
decisions.existingPhase0: Clean v2 paths and architecture; v1 preserved as evidence only.
decisions.conflict: None material.
decisions.requiredRevision: None.

decisions.foundation: Reuse data-driven lessons, history, static hosting, and migrations conceptually.
decisions.audit: Does not require a new repository.
decisions.existingPhase0: Isolated v2 branches and paths in the current repository.
decisions.conflict: None.
decisions.requiredRevision: None.

decisions.foundation: Attention economy plus projects plus simplified dependencies.
decisions.audit: Supported with revision; must avoid a solved allocation dashboard.
decisions.existingPhase0: Candidate F with staged disclosure and later priority automation.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Six-candidate heuristic comparison across five weight sets.
decisions.conflict: Experiment is comparative evidence, not proof of fun.
decisions.requiredRevision: Retain F; require Phase 1 decision-density policies and Phase 2 playtests.

decisions.foundation: Finite allocation; representation not locked.
decisions.audit: Requires discrete/percentage/queue and slider-fatigue comparison.
decisions.existingPhase0: Whole slots with plus/minus, tap, and presets.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Control comparison favors discrete accessible controls.
decisions.conflict: No empirical usability study.
decisions.requiredRevision: Lock discrete controls structurally; keep comprehension as a playtest gate.

decisions.foundation: Six in the preliminary simulation; explicitly provisional.
decisions.audit: Exactly six is unsupported; compare 3-8.
decisions.existingPhase0: Start at 3.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Capacity/policy-count enumeration and mobile burden comparison.
decisions.conflict: Foundation prototype used four lanes and projects; Phase 0 uses two production lanes and a dedicated project slot.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep 3 as configuration; opening audit must acknowledge guided actions.

decisions.foundation: Capacity persists and may expand; no validated count.
decisions.audit: Expansion must be tested with automation and mobile clarity.
decisions.existingPhase0: Fourth slot unlocks during Natural Numbers.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Four slots yield five legible two-lane allocations.
decisions.conflict: Timing is not simulated end-to-end.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep 3→4 in content configuration and validate timing/policy impact.

decisions.foundation: 0.90 for activities and 0.85 for project Attention.
decisions.audit: Both are arbitrary pending a 0.70-1.00 sweep and alternatives.
decisions.existingPhase0: 0.80 center.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: 0.70-1.00 sweep; 0.85-0.90 produce more all-in winners in tested weighted contexts.
decisions.conflict: One exponent must not silently cover activities and projects.
decisions.requiredRevision: Apply 0.80 only to production activities; projects use linear work plus typed effects; keep explicit-marginal alternative open.

decisions.foundation: Projects compete directly for Attention with production.
decisions.audit: Competition is a blocking hypothesis requiring comparison.
decisions.existingPhase0: One dedicated project slot; project execution does not consume Attention.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Core-loop workload comparison and two-lane capacity audit.
decisions.conflict: Direct competition adds opportunity cost but can force production pauses/deadlocks with only 3-4 slots.
decisions.requiredRevision: Retain dedicated slot; preserve opportunity cost through reserved inputs, project order, approach outputs, and queue/reserve policy; simulate contrary model in Phase 1.

decisions.foundation: Precision, Intuition, and Technique.
decisions.audit: One-to-four resource comparison required; distinct sinks are the burden of proof.
decisions.existingPhase0: Precision and Intuition only.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Reconciled six-model comparison favors two stocks plus visible project-method state.
decisions.conflict: Removing the Technique stock risks erasing exercises/practice.
decisions.requiredRevision: Retain two primary stocks; require visible Technique method state and artifacts rather than a third currency.

decisions.foundation: Definition/formal-work stock.
decisions.audit: Viable only with exclusive sinks.
decisions.existingPhase0: Formal obligations, definitions, and lemma sinks.
decisions.conflict: Gate-currency risk remains.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep removal/sink-share balance gates.

decisions.foundation: Examples/discovery/active-opportunity stock.
decisions.audit: Viable only with exclusive sinks.
decisions.existingPhase0: Examples, counterexamples, alternate requirements, and reveals.
decisions.conflict: Must not become a reveal tax.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep comprehension and sink-share gates.

decisions.foundation: Exercise-produced primary stock used for methods and automation.
decisions.audit: Thematically strong but functionally unproven; exclusive sinks required.
decisions.existingPhase0: Rejected as a stock and represented through project behavior.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Reconciled model favors explicit project-method state over an invisible efficiency capability.
decisions.conflict: Technique must remain visible without making universal automation a mandatory currency tax.
decisions.requiredRevision: Use visible exercise projects, prepared-method state, and typed step/template artifacts; do not add a Natural Numbers Technique stock.

decisions.foundation: Cumulative chapter progress/unlock measure, not universal spendable currency.
decisions.audit: One simulation-ready diagram spends it on routine upgrades, but labels that economy a draft.
decisions.existingPhase0: Monotonic validated-content score; never spent.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Legacy one-resource failure and resource simplification audit.
decisions.conflict: Audit draft conflicts with its own warning against collapsing decisions into currencies.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep non-spendable; document the audit diagram as superseded draft evidence.

decisions.foundation: Bounded strategic resource from active/return/discovery events.
decisions.audit: Favor bounded 10-20% total advantage and accessibility.
decisions.existingPhase0: Deterministic stored charges with optional work/reveal interventions.
decisions.conflict: Exact cadence/effect untested.
decisions.requiredRevision: Retain deterministic event generation; keep cap/effect numerical values provisional.

decisions.foundation: Durable chapter/publication progress.
decisions.audit: Publication compression is supported.
decisions.existingPhase0: Typed published method records, not arithmetic currency.
decisions.conflict: None.
decisions.requiredRevision: None.

decisions.foundation: Major prestige currency.
decisions.audit: Framing is plausible but reset purpose/timing are unproven.
decisions.existingPhase0: No Axiom currency or formula.
decisions.conflict: Publication may already serve compression/account growth.
decisions.requiredRevision: Reserve no currency fields beyond a nullable versioned extension point.

decisions.foundation: Soft-capped conversion upgrades are proposed.
decisions.audit: Currencies must retain exclusive sinks and avoid colored interchangeability.
decisions.existingPhase0: No Precision↔Intuition conversion in Natural Numbers.
decisions.conflict: Conversions could erase the two-stock trade-off.
decisions.requiredRevision: Reject direct Natural Numbers conversion; later chapters require a new source-sink proof.

decisions.foundation: Automation is a core pillar but also a proposed branch.
decisions.audit: Basic anti-tedium automation must be universal.
decisions.existingPhase0: Universal queue/completion/reserve ladder.
decisions.conflict: None after revision.
decisions.requiredRevision: Explicitly keep every Natural Numbers automation entry global.

decisions.foundation: Rigor/Intuition/Automation first-run branches.
decisions.audit: Creates a quality-of-life trap unless baseline automation remains universal.
decisions.existingPhase0: No automation branch.
decisions.conflict: Foundation identity conflicts with universal anti-tedium rule.
decisions.requiredRevision: Constructive method identity replaces automation branch behavior; automation remains universal.

decisions.foundation: Three respecable first-run branches.
decisions.audit: Behavioral identities plausible, but branch trees/dominance/recovery are missing.
decisions.existingPhase0: No permanent Natural Numbers branch; later campaign identity deferred.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Temporary approaches score higher on reversibility/trap/scope criteria.
decisions.conflict: Temporary identity may provide less replay/build attachment.
decisions.requiredRevision: Revisit only after three mechanically distinct chapters and a multi-chapter policy simulation.

decisions.foundation: Not the primary branch model.
decisions.audit: Calls for behavioral choices and poor-choice recovery.
decisions.existingPhase0: Formal, Exploratory, Constructive per project.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Five-model branch comparison favors reversible approaches.
decisions.conflict: Persistent build identity is weaker.
decisions.requiredRevision: Require outputs/artifacts to alter downstream decisions and keep campaign frameworks deferred.

decisions.foundation: Permanent Rigor branch emphasizes Precision/proof efficiency.
decisions.audit: Must change behavior, not multipliers.
decisions.existingPhase0: Formal project approach exposes obligations and reusable lemmas.
decisions.conflict: Permanent identity removed.
decisions.requiredRevision: Retain as per-project Formal behavior; do not add a rate-only Rigor branch.

decisions.foundation: Permanent Intuition branch emphasizes discovery/active rewards.
decisions.audit: Must change behavior and not punish offline play.
decisions.existingPhase0: Exploratory approach reveals examples, requirements, and alternate edges.
decisions.conflict: Permanent identity removed.
decisions.requiredRevision: Retain as per-project Exploratory behavior; keep active accessibility equal.

decisions.foundation: Automation branch and Technique/Exercise lane.
decisions.audit: Automation must be universal; Technique needs exclusive visible purpose.
decisions.existingPhase0: Constructive approach emits reusable steps/templates.
decisions.conflict: Practice risked vanishing when the Technique stock was removed.
decisions.requiredRevision: Make exercises/method preparation visible through Constructive project state; keep automation unlocks global.

decisions.foundation: Roughly 15-35% and possibly below 40% long-horizon.
decisions.audit: Safer target is 10-20% total advantage.
decisions.existingPhase0: 10-15% target and 20% hard ceiling.
decisions.conflict: No human usefulness/FOMO evidence.
decisions.requiredRevision: Retain current target/ceiling as configuration and accessibility-inclusive playtest gate.

decisions.foundation: Bounded storage, exact cap not supported.
decisions.audit: Bounded active play supported; exact cap needs tests.
decisions.existingPhase0: Cap 3.
decisions.conflict: No cadence/hoarding playtest.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep 3 in validated configuration.

decisions.foundation: Periodic stored charges; random project failure rejected.
decisions.audit: Bounded opportunities and accessibility are required.
decisions.existingPhase0: Deterministic meaningful-event charges; no timed popup.
decisions.conflict: Audit simulation mentions Monte Carlo event timing, but that is a comparator rather than a requirement.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep base game deterministic; any future stochastic challenge uses explicit serialized RNG.

decisions.foundation: 8 hours.
decisions.audit: 4/8/12/24-hour comparison required; no value is proven.
decisions.existingPhase0: 12 hours.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Reconciled window table computes effective credit for four schedules.
decisions.conflict: Retention/fairness is not measured.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep 12h as configurable center, not a locked product promise.

decisions.foundation: Decline through 48 hours.
decisions.audit: Exact tail and unresolved semantics remain uncertain.
decisions.existingPhase0: 25% from 12 to 72 hours.
decisions.conflict: No return-cohort evidence.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep 25%/72h center in validated configuration and compare in Phase 2.

decisions.foundation: Stop when automation cannot choose.
decisions.audit: Supported with revision; too-strict stops can punish idle play.
decisions.existingPhase0: Typed event taxonomy and deterministic stop reason.
decisions.conflict: Stop taxonomy must distinguish harmless unlocks from choices.
decisions.requiredRevision: Continue existing allocations through informational unlocks; stop at project/approach/capstone/Publication or unresolved cap/policy failures.

decisions.foundation: Saved allocation/automation executes the plan.
decisions.audit: Explicit safe policy after unresolved events is recommended.
decisions.existingPhase0: Queue, completion behavior, and reserves gate continuation.
decisions.conflict: No auto-buy/approach selection without explicit future rules.
decisions.requiredRevision: None beyond full Phase 1 equivalence tests.

decisions.foundation: Chapter completion/compression before major prestige.
decisions.audit: Strongly supported and distinct from frequent reset.
decisions.existingPhase0: Typed chapter transformation after capstone.
decisions.conflict: None.
decisions.requiredRevision: None.

decisions.foundation: Local chapter completion; exact matrix requested.
decisions.audit: Requires exact retention/compression interaction.
decisions.existingPhase0: Stocks, allocation, active/queued projects, chapter reserves/modifiers reset.
decisions.conflict: Foundation mentioned temporary allocations resetting on major prestige, not a complete Publication matrix.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep explicit field-level ledger and reducer tests.

decisions.foundation: Mastery, automation, and compressed methods persist.
decisions.audit: Supported; avoid replaying tutorial labor.
decisions.existingPhase0: Settings, records, capabilities/templates, Insight, Mastery, and method cards persist.
decisions.conflict: None.
decisions.requiredRevision: None.

decisions.foundation: Reaxiomatization recommended after enough systems.
decisions.audit: Melvor comparison shows prestige is optional; must have a unique job.
decisions.existingPhase0: No prestige implementation until a multi-chapter proof.
decisions.conflict: Foundation recommends a system whose unique function is not yet established.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep nullable extension point only.

decisions.foundation: Likely Real Numbers or first Foundations arc.
decisions.audit: No evidence privileges Real Numbers; compare several breakpoints/no prestige.
decisions.existingPhase0: No timing selected.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Eight timing/purpose options, no validated reset benefit.
decisions.conflict: None after deferral.
decisions.requiredRevision: Multi-chapter simulator/playtest required.

decisions.foundation: Candidate breadth/mastery/proof/efficiency formula.
decisions.audit: Currency/name depend on actual reset purpose and retention.
decisions.existingPhase0: No Axiom formula or arithmetic field.
decisions.conflict: Formula would falsely lock an unproven reset.
decisions.requiredRevision: No Phase 1 formula/UI/content.

decisions.foundation: 30-50m active, 45-75m hybrid, 2-4h mostly idle.
decisions.audit: 30-75m engaged is supported with revision; compare 15-120 and fatigue.
decisions.existingPhase0: 120-180 active-equivalent minutes.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Reconciled five-band design-density comparison favors 60-90, with 90-120 close.
decisions.conflict: The previous Phase 0 range over-weighted content room and under-weighted first-chapter fatigue.
decisions.requiredRevision: Use configurable 60-120 active-equivalent minutes over 1-3 sessions; Phase 2 simulator/playtest must narrow it.

decisions.foundation: Finite staged curriculum; no validated hour target.
decisions.audit: No campaign-duration evidence.
decisions.existingPhase0: 30-50 active-equivalent hours over 4-8 weeks.
decisions.conflict: Chapter count and production scope can move the estimate.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep 30-50h envelope as configuration/planning estimate, not retention promise.

decisions.foundation: Each chapter introduces a unique mechanic and transforms prior work.
decisions.audit: Strongly favors phase changes and compression; later content remains unproven.
decisions.existingPhase0: Finite initial campaign with chapter standard and optional mastery/postgame.
decisions.conflict: Later chapter designs are hypotheses, not content locks.
decisions.requiredRevision: Lock the chapter contract, not later chapter data or exact length.

decisions.foundation: 60-70% cosmetic/records, 20-30% feature/challenge, at most 10-15% small mechanics.
decisions.audit: Mostly non-power, with a minority of unlocks/limited utility; no mandatory multiplier ladder.
decisions.existingPhase0: All 10 badge/history only.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Achievement-tax audit; no power model needed for non-power unlocks.
decisions.conflict: All-badge policy leaves useful discovery/record/challenge rewards unexplored.
decisions.requiredRevision: Use 7 badge/history achievements and 3 explicit non-power record/challenge/visual-information unlocks; zero production power.

decisions.foundation: Natural Numbers challenge examples are proposed.
decisions.audit: Challenges are replay/mastery tools and need full rules/rewards.
decisions.existingPhase0: No challenge UI before first Publication; schema extension only.
decisions.conflict: Foundation does not require them during the first run.
decisions.requiredRevision: Retain post-Publication prototype timing.

decisions.foundation: Preact or React acceptable if engine is independent.
decisions.audit: Framework choice unresolved by genre evidence; prototype/bundle/maintenance comparison required.
decisions.existingPhase0: Preact + TypeScript + Vite.
decisions.conflict: Scores are heuristic and bundle is unmeasured.
decisions.requiredRevision: Retain Preact for Phase 1 with bundle, compat, accessibility, and testing exit gates.

decisions.foundation: Acceptable alternative with broader tooling.
decisions.audit: Not proven necessary.
decisions.existingPhase0: Not selected.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Scores close on clarity/testing but lower on scope/bundle criterion.
decisions.conflict: Could become justified by React-only dependencies, which are currently absent.
decisions.requiredRevision: Remain documented fallback only if Preact exit gates fail.

decisions.foundation: Not recommended for production but not prohibited.
decisions.audit: Requires measured comparison.
decisions.existingPhase0: Used only for disposable prototype; production selects Preact.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: v1 monolithic UI audit and frontend criteria comparison.
decisions.conflict: Small runtime does not offset bespoke update/composition cost at intended UI complexity.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep for prototypes only.

decisions.foundation: Use a large-number library only if simulations prove it necessary.
decisions.audit: Campaign magnitude/operation/serialization evidence required.
decisions.existingPhase0: Native number behind an opaque adapter with finite/precision gates.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Range envelope through initial campaign remains below overflow.
decisions.conflict: Integer precision can fail long before overflow.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep adapter/canonical strings and both magnitude and meaningful-increment migration gates.

decisions.foundation: Conditional dependency only.
decisions.audit: Need campaign ceiling and backend comparison.
decisions.existingPhase0: Adapter boundary exists; no large-number library.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Postgame-only envelope may exceed native finite range.
decisions.conflict: No reachable Phase 1 content needs it.
decisions.requiredRevision: Do not add dependency; preserve backend-independent fixtures/migration path.

decisions.foundation: Namespaced save envelope and rotating local backups.
decisions.audit: A compact localStorage heartbeat/current record is suitable in a dual-layer design.
decisions.existingPhase0: Canonical current/rotating backups in localStorage.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Small-envelope scope and browser storage audit.
decisions.conflict: Synchronous writes and quota limit long histories.
decisions.requiredRevision: Use localStorage for current canonical envelope, settings, writer lease, and fallback backups only.

decisions.foundation: Not required initially; structured storage is compatible.
decisions.audit: Recommended for larger structured backups, replay logs, and future telemetry snapshots.
decisions.existingPhase0: Reserved for logs/measured growth.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Storage characteristics/scope audit, not performance benchmark.
decisions.conflict: Adding canonical IDB state now would increase transactional/failure complexity.
decisions.requiredRevision: Phase 1 defines native IDB port and writes append-only backups/replay logs when available; localStorage current remains canonical and fallback-safe.

decisions.foundation: Preserve direct static hosting.
decisions.audit: Compatible with browser-first architecture.
decisions.existingPhase0: Vite static build with /Analysis-Idle/ base; no deployment now.
decisions.conflict: None.
decisions.requiredRevision: None.

decisions.foundation: Future browser offline/installable option.
decisions.audit: Service workers are relevant but lifecycle/data-integrity work comes first.
decisions.existingPhase0: Deferred until save, update, cache, downgrade, and multi-tab tests.
decisions.conflict: None.
decisions.requiredRevision: No Phase 1 PWA/plugin.

decisions.foundation: Restrained academic tone and mechanic-exposing mathematical visuals.
decisions.audit: UI should compress and avoid an overgrown dashboard.
decisions.existingPhase0: Living mathematical notebook / academic instrument; procedural SVG/CSS/Canvas.
decisions.conflict: Visual originality and production contrast remain untested.
decisions.requiredRevision: Retain direction provisionally; validate three production screens before final assets.

decisions.foundation: Keyboard/mobile/math alternatives and no raw LaTeX.
decisions.audit: Active/offline/interface choices must respect access and background play.
decisions.existingPhase0: WCAG 2.2 AA, 44px targets, reduced motion, color-independent state, accessible math.
decisions.experimentalEvidence: Prototype accessible-tree and control audit plus official standards.
decisions.conflict: None structural; assistive-technology variance remains.
decisions.requiredRevision: Keep automated and manual AT/mobile matrices as release gates.

provisionalValues.validation: opening comprehension and capacity policy sweep
0.70-1.00 sweep plus explicit-marginal comparator and playtest
Phase 1 simulator and Phase 2 fatigue/comprehension playtest
chapter production estimates and multi-chapter playtest

retained: clean rewrite in the existing repository
3→4 discrete Attention as a provisional configuration
Precision and Intuition as primary stocks
unresolved-decision offline stepping and safe policies
Preact, native-number adapter, GitHub Pages, and WCAG 2.2 AA
revised: Technique is retained visibly as exercise/project-method state and typed artifacts, not rejected conceptually or added as a stock
the 0.80 exponent applies only to production activities, not projects
the opening explicitly labels its first action as guided rather than strategic
first Publication changes from 120-180 to a provisional 60-120 active-equivalent minute band
achievement rewards change from 10 badge-only to 7 badge/history plus 3 non-power unlocks
storage becomes explicit dual-layer: localStorage current/fallback plus IndexedDB backups/replay logs
superseded: React or plain DOM as the selected Phase 1 UI stack
the audit's draft suggestion that Understanding pay for routine upgrades
deferred: PWA, audio, later chapters, localization, and postgame
